text: 9月10日，中国商务部研究院国际服务贸易研究所在服贸会上发布《入境游促进消费的内在机理及增长潜力研究》，该报告在携程集团支持下完成，报告尤其关注中国入境游发展现状与特点。报告称，中国入境游已形成较好基础，有望迈入高质量发展新阶段，预计未来10年中国入境旅游收入占GDP比重有望提升至国际平均水平，这意味着约1万亿至3万亿元人民币的潜在市场增量。（环球时报）
text_en: On September 10, the Institute of International Trade in Services at the Chinese Academy of International Trade and Economic Cooperation under the Ministry of Commerce released the "Research on the Intrinsic Mechanisms and Growth Potential of Inbound Tourism in Promoting Consumption" at the China International Fair for Trade in Services. The report, completed with support from Trip.com Group, focuses in particular on the current state and characteristics of China's inbound tourism development. The report states that China's inbound tourism has formed a solid foundation and is expected to enter a new stage of high-quality development. It is projected that in the next 10 years, the share of China's inbound tourism revenue in GDP is expected to rise to the international average level, implying a potential market increment of approximately 1 trillion to 3 trillion yuan. (Global Times)
